summary: Tested reminder CRUD real-time refresh fix (iteration 149). The fix using local state (localRems) in ReminderCRUDPopup is NOT working. Backend API calls succeed (200 OK, new reminder created), but the UI does NOT update immediately. The count stays the same after ADD/DELETE/TOGGLE operations.

critical.issue: Local state fix (localRems + updateRems) is not working - UI does not refresh immediately after ADD/DELETE/TOGGLE operations
critical.selector: text=Ajouter un rappel, i.ri-delete-bin-line, toggle switches
critical.details: The updateRems function calls both setLocalRems and setReminders, but the UI does not re-render with the new data. API calls succeed (verified via network monitoring - new reminder ID returned), but the popup content stays unchanged.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/reminders returns 200 OK with new reminder ID, updateRems called, but popup count stays the same (3 -> 3 instead of 3 -> 4)
PUT /api/reminders/{id}/toggle returns 200 OK, updateRems called, but toggle visual state doesn't change
DELETE /api/reminders/{id} returns 200 OK, setLocalRems called, but popup count stays the same

action_items: CRITICAL: The local state fix (localRems + updateRems) is not working as expected
Investigate why setLocalRems is not triggering a re-render of the popup content
Possible issue: The useEffect on line 140 might be overwriting localRems with stale parentReminders
Possible issue: React batching might be causing the state updates to not propagate correctly
Alternative fix: Use a key prop on the popup to force re-mount when reminders change
Alternative fix: Use useReducer instead of useState for more predictable state updates
Alternative fix: Call fetchData() after each CRUD operation to refresh from server

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The local state fix (localRems + updateRems) is not working. The updateRems function calls both setLocalRems and setReminders, but the UI does not re-render. Possible causes: (1) The useEffect on line 140 might be overwriting localRems with stale parentReminders before the parent state update propagates, (2) React batching might be causing issues with the order of state updates, (3) The React Portal might have stale closure issues.
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to dashboard and scroll to 'Mes rappels' section
3. Click on 'Hydratation' card to open ReminderCRUDPopup
6. Observe: API call succeeds (network shows 200 OK with new reminder ID)
7. Observe: UI count does NOT increase (stays at 3)
8. Close popup and reopen - count is now updated (shows 4)
mitigation_steps: Option 1: Call fetchData() after each CRUD operation to refresh from server (simple but adds latency)
Option 2: Use a key prop on the popup component that changes when reminders change (forces re-mount)
Option 3: Use useReducer instead of useState for more predictable state updates
Option 4: Remove the useEffect sync and only use localRems, updating it directly in handlers
Option 5: Use React.memo with custom comparison to prevent unnecessary re-renders
